lines: My right hand rushes, goes wild, spurring the tempo.
I thought while trying to soothe it.
I want my right hand to tease me too.
With white fingers that follow a line.
Again I'm being toyed with like that.
Sound falls away from left to right.
In the next life I want to become your guitar.
I want to press close and sway wildly.
In this life I want to be your girlfriend.
Just in the dream is enough.
A frantic tempo, a broken rhythm, a memory I can't recall.
A story that makes no sense.
I press my hand to my mouth while blurt­ing out.
Again I'm being toyed with like that.
My hopes slip away from that girl.
In the next life I want to become your guitar.
I want to press close and sway wildly.
In this life I want to be your girlfriend.
